claim: Regular aerobic exercise improves insulin sensitivity in adults with type 2 diabetes.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Participants who completed 12 weeks of moderate aerobic training showed significantly improved insulin sensitivity compared to sedentary controls.

claim: Handwashing with soap has no measurable effect on reducing diarrheal disease incidence.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Handwashing with soap at key times was associated with a substantial reduction in diarrheal disease incidence across community-based trials.

claim: Intermittent fasting improves long-term cardiovascular outcomes in the general population.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The reviewed abstract discusses short-term metabolic markers only and does not report long-term cardiovascular outcome data.

claim: Sleep deprivation impairs short-term memory consolidation.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Subjects restricted to four hours of sleep performed significantly worse on delayed recall tasks than the control group.

claim: Statin therapy has no effect on LDL cholesterol levels.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Statin-treated patients showed a marked reduction in LDL cholesterol compared to placebo across all trial arms.

claim: Omega-3 fatty acid supplementation prevents the onset of Alzheimer's disease.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study measured omega-3 blood levels but did not track incidence of Alzheimer's diagnosis in participants.

claim: Mediterranean diet adherence is associated with lower risk of cardiovascular events.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: High adherence to a Mediterranean-style diet was linked to a significantly reduced rate of major cardiovascular events.

claim: Antibiotic use in early childhood has no association with later obesity risk.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Children who received multiple antibiotic courses before age two showed significantly higher BMI z-scores by age five.

claim: Probiotic supplementation cures major depressive disorder.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The trial reported changes in gut microbiota composition but did not assess clinical depression outcomes.

claim: Second-hand smoke exposure increases the risk of childhood asthma.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Children living in households with regular tobacco smoke exposure had a significantly higher incidence of asthma diagnoses.

claim: High-dose vitamin C supplementation prevents the common cold in the general population.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Routine vitamin C supplementation did not reduce the incidence of colds among trial participants in the general population.

claim: Gut microbiome composition influences response to cancer immunotherapy.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Patients with higher microbial diversity showed significantly improved response rates to checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

claim: Blue light exposure from screens causes permanent retinal damage in adults.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study measured short-term visual fatigue symptoms but did not assess long-term retinal tissue changes.

claim: Bariatric surgery leads to remission of type 2 diabetes in a majority of severely obese patients.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: A majority of severely obese patients achieved diabetes remission within one year following bariatric surgery.

claim: Coffee consumption has no association with reduced risk of Parkinson's disease.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Regular coffee drinkers showed a significantly lower incidence of Parkinson's disease compared to non-drinkers.

claim: Red meat consumption directly causes colorectal cancer in all individuals.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The abstract reports an association between processed meat intake and colorectal cancer risk but does not establish direct causation for all individuals.

claim: Early mobilization after surgery reduces the incidence of postoperative pneumonia.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Patients mobilized within 24 hours of surgery had a significantly lower rate of postoperative pneumonia.

claim: Breastfeeding has no effect on infant immune system development.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Breastfed infants showed measurably stronger immune responses to early vaccinations compared to formula-fed infants.

claim: Air pollution exposure during pregnancy affects fetal brain development.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study measured maternal exposure levels but did not include direct assessment of fetal neurodevelopmental outcomes.

claim: Hand hygiene compliance among healthcare workers reduces hospital-acquired infection rates.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Wards with higher hand hygiene compliance recorded significantly fewer hospital-acquired infections.

claim: Moderate alcohol consumption has no association with increased breast cancer risk.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Women who consumed moderate amounts of alcohol regularly showed a modestly but significantly elevated risk of breast cancer.

claim: Artificial sweeteners cause insulin resistance in healthy adults.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The trial assessed short-term glucose response only and did not evaluate long-term insulin resistance development.

claim: Cognitive behavioral therapy reduces symptoms of generalized anxiety disorder.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Patients receiving cognitive behavioral therapy reported a significant reduction in generalized anxiety symptoms compared to waitlist controls.

claim: Vaccination against HPV has no effect on cervical cancer incidence.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Populations with high HPV vaccination coverage showed a substantial decline in cervical cancer incidence over the follow-up period.

claim: Meditation practice reverses age-related cognitive decline entirely.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study reported modest improvements in attention scores but did not assess whether cognitive decline was reversed.

claim: Low physical activity levels are associated with increased risk of depression.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Individuals reporting low weekly physical activity had significantly higher rates of diagnosed depression.

claim: Fluoride in drinking water has no effect on dental caries prevalence.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Communities with fluoridated water supplies showed significantly lower rates of dental caries among children.

claim: Prenatal exposure to acetaminophen causes autism spectrum disorder.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The abstract identifies a statistical association but explicitly states causation could not be established from the observational design.

claim: Adequate hydration improves cognitive performance during prolonged physical exertion.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Participants who maintained adequate hydration performed significantly better on cognitive tasks after prolonged exercise.

claim: Regular flu vaccination has no effect on hospitalization rates among the elderly.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Elderly patients who received annual flu vaccination had significantly lower rates of influenza-related hospitalization.

claim: Screen time before bed has no effect on sleep quality in adolescents.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Adolescents with high pre-sleep screen time reported significantly poorer sleep quality and delayed sleep onset.

claim: Music therapy improves emotional wellbeing in dementia patients.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Dementia patients receiving structured music therapy sessions showed significant improvements in reported emotional wellbeing.

claim: Ketogenic diets cure epilepsy in all pediatric patients.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study reports seizure frequency reduction in a subset of pediatric patients but does not claim a cure across all cases.

claim: Air filtration systems reduce indoor transmission of airborne respiratory viruses.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Rooms equipped with HEPA filtration showed significantly reduced airborne viral particle concentrations.

claim: Chronic sleep debt has no association with increased cardiovascular disease risk.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Individuals with chronic sleep debt exhibited significantly elevated markers of cardiovascular risk compared to well-rested controls.

claim: Occupational exposure to asbestos increases the risk of mesothelioma.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Workers with documented asbestos exposure showed a significantly elevated incidence of mesothelioma over the follow-up period.

claim: Daily multivitamin use extends overall life expectancy in healthy adults.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study measured micronutrient blood levels but did not track mortality or life expectancy outcomes.

claim: Early childhood exposure to a second language improves later executive function.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Children exposed to a second language before age five scored significantly higher on executive function assessments.

claim: Chewing gum has no effect on reducing post-surgical ileus recovery time.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Patients who chewed gum after abdominal surgery had significantly faster return of bowel function than controls.

claim: High dietary salt intake causes hypertension in every individual regardless of genetics.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The abstract reports a population-level association between salt intake and blood pressure but does not address individual genetic variation.

claim: Structured exercise programs reduce fall risk in elderly populations.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Elderly participants in structured balance and strength programs experienced significantly fewer falls than the control group.

claim: Antidepressant use during pregnancy has no association with any neonatal outcomes.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Neonates exposed to antidepressants in utero showed a modestly increased rate of transient adaptation symptoms after birth.

claim: Urban green space exposure improves self-reported mental health outcomes.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Residents with greater access to urban green space reported significantly better mental health scores.

claim: Wearable fitness trackers directly cause improved long-term weight loss outcomes in all users.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study measured short-term step count changes but did not report long-term weight outcomes across the full user population.

claim: Nicotine replacement therapy has no effect on smoking cessation success rates.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Smokers using nicotine replacement therapy achieved significantly higher cessation rates than those attempting to quit unaided.

claim: Prolonged sitting time is associated with increased risk of type 2 diabetes independent of exercise.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Individuals with high daily sitting time showed elevated diabetes risk even after adjusting for total physical activity.

claim: Herbal supplements are equally effective as prescription antidepressants for severe depression.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The trial included only mild depression cases and did not evaluate efficacy in severe depression.

claim: Early antibiotic treatment reduces mortality in sepsis patients.
label: SUPPORT
evidence: Sepsis patients who received antibiotics within one hour of diagnosis had significantly lower mortality rates.

claim: Noise pollution exposure has no effect on cardiovascular health.
label: CONTRADICT
evidence: Long-term exposure to high traffic noise was associated with a significantly elevated risk of cardiovascular events.

claim: Telemedicine consultations are equally effective as in-person visits for all medical specialties.
label: NOT ENOUGH INFO
evidence: The study evaluated telemedicine outcomes only within primary care and did not assess other medical specialties.
